summary: When partial integer parsing encounters an invalid digit after a negative number, it returns the unsigned magnitude without applying the negative sign: parsing "-1a" as i8 returns Ok((1, 2)) instead of Ok((-1, 2)). The fix applies wrapping negation before converting the accumulated value to the signed result. The fix adds a detecting assertion to i8_decimal_test in lexical-parse-integer/tests/api_tests.rs. Both reversal regions occur exactly once, and replacing the fixed region restores the parent implementation file exactly. Tests were not run.
